0.heading: Overview
refs: Psa 144:1 , David blesses God for his mercy both to him and to man
Psa 144:5 , He prays that God would powerfully deliver him from his enemies
Psa 144:9 , He promises to praise God
Psa 144:11 , He prays for the happy state of the kingdom.
Calmet and others think that this Psalm was composed by David after the death of Absalom
and from a collation of it with Psa. 18 , in which the same ideas and form of expression occur, there can be no doubt of both having proceeded from the same pen, and that David was the author.
